sentences.text: La dentiste propose à Antoine une petite biopsie de la gencive, par simple précaution.
sentences.en: The dentist offers Antoine a small gum biopsy, just as a precaution.
sentences.ko: 치과 의사가 안토니에게 예방 차원에서 잇몸 조직 검사를 권해요.

sentences.text: Sarah apprend qu'une voisine attend le résultat d'une biopsie et lui offre des fleurs.
sentences.en: Sarah learns that a neighbour is waiting for a biopsy result and gives her flowers.
sentences.ko: 사라는 이웃이 조직 검사 결과를 기다린다는 말을 듣고 꽃을 선물해요.

sentences.text: Antoine serre tellement les dents la nuit qu'il souffre d'une tension musculaire dans la mâchoire.
sentences.en: Antoine clenches his teeth so hard at night that he has muscle tension in his jaw.
sentences.ko: 안토니는 밤에 이를 너무 꽉 물어서 턱 근육이 뭉쳐 있어요.

sentences.text: En portant les caisses d'eau, Sarah ressent une douleur musculaire dans le dos.
sentences.en: Carrying the cases of water, Sarah feels a muscle pain in her back.
sentences.ko: 사라는 생수 상자를 나르다 등 근육이 아파요.

sentences.text: Après l'anesthésie, Antoine sent une légère paralysie de la lèvre pendant une heure.
sentences.en: After the anaesthetic, Antoine feels a slight numbness in his lip for an hour.
sentences.ko: 마취 뒤 안토니는 한 시간 동안 입술이 살짝 마비된 느낌이에요.

sentences.text: Le vieux client de Sarah marche avec une canne depuis une paralysie partielle.
sentences.en: Sarah's elderly customer walks with a cane since a partial paralysis.
sentences.ko: 사라의 나이 든 단골손님은 부분 마비 뒤로 지팡이를 짚고 다녀요.

sentences.text: La radio montre à Antoine une petite perte osseuse autour de la dent.
sentences.en: The X-ray shows Antoine a small loss of bone around the tooth.
sentences.ko: 엑스레이를 보니 안토니의 치아 주변 뼈가 조금 줄었어요.

sentences.text: Sarah vend un bouillon osseux maison que les sportifs adorent.
sentences.en: Sarah sells a homemade bone broth that athletes love.
sentences.ko: 사라는 운동하는 사람들이 좋아하는 직접 끓인 사골 국물을 팔아요.

sentences.text: Dans la salle d'attente, Antoine lit une affiche sur la diarrhée du voyageur.
sentences.en: In the waiting room, Antoine reads a poster about traveller's diarrhoea.
sentences.ko: 대기실에서 안토니는 여행자 설사에 관한 포스터를 읽어요.

sentences.text: Un touriste demande à Sarah un médicament contre la diarrhée.
sentences.en: A tourist asks Sarah for something for diarrhoea.
sentences.ko: 한 관광객이 사라에게 설사약을 찾아요.

sentences.text: Antoine porte un protège-dents depuis qu'il a commencé à boxer.
sentences.en: Antoine has worn a mouthguard since he started boxing.
sentences.ko: 안토니는 권투를 시작한 뒤로 마우스가드를 껴요.

sentences.text: Le neveu de Sarah apprend à boxer et s'entraîne derrière la boutique.
sentences.en: Sarah's nephew is learning to box and trains behind the shop.
sentences.ko: 사라의 조카는 권투를 배우는데 가게 뒤에서 연습해요.

sentences.text: L'assistante raconte à Antoine qu'une épidémie de gale a fermé l'école de son fils.
sentences.en: The assistant tells Antoine that a scabies outbreak closed her son's school.
sentences.ko: 위생사가 안토니에게 옴이 퍼져서 아들 학교가 문을 닫았다고 말해요.

sentences.text: Sarah a lu que la gale revient dans certaines écoles cet hiver.
sentences.en: Sarah read that scabies is coming back in some schools this winter.
sentences.ko: 사라는 올겨울 몇몇 학교에 옴이 다시 돈다는 기사를 읽었어요.

sentences.text: La dentiste explique à Antoine qu'elle soigne aussi des patients atteints de démence.
sentences.en: The dentist explains to Antoine that she also treats patients with dementia.
sentences.ko: 치과 의사는 치매 환자도 치료한다고 안토니에게 설명해요.

sentences.text: La mère de Sarah, atteinte de démence, vient parfois s'asseoir près de la caisse.
sentences.en: Sarah's mother, who has dementia, sometimes comes to sit near the till.
sentences.ko: 치매를 앓는 사라의 어머니가 가끔 계산대 옆에 와 앉아요.

sentences.text: La petite plaie dans la bouche d'Antoine n'est pas un ulcère, rassure la dentiste.
sentences.en: The small sore in Antoine's mouth isn't an ulcer, the dentist reassures him.
sentences.ko: 치과 의사는 안토니 입안의 작은 상처가 궤양은 아니라며 안심시켜요.

sentences.text: Un client explique à Sarah qu'il évite le café à cause de son ulcère.
sentences.en: A customer explains to Sarah that he avoids coffee because of his ulcer.
sentences.ko: 한 손님이 궤양 때문에 커피를 피한다고 사라에게 말해요.

sentences.text: Antoine a lu un article sur un acteur qui a survécu à un anévrisme.
sentences.en: Antoine read an article about an actor who survived an aneurysm.
sentences.ko: 안토니는 동맥류를 이겨 낸 한 배우에 관한 기사를 읽었어요.

sentences.text: Le médecin du quartier a détecté un anévrisme chez l'oncle de Sarah juste à temps.
sentences.en: The local doctor spotted an aneurysm in Sarah's uncle just in time.
sentences.ko: 동네 의사가 사라 삼촌의 동맥류를 제때 찾아냈어요.

sentences.text: Une défaillance du fauteuil électrique oblige Antoine à changer de salle.
sentences.en: A fault in the electric chair forces Antoine to change rooms.
sentences.ko: 전동 의자가 고장 나서 안토니는 다른 진료실로 옮겨요.

sentences.text: Une défaillance du réfrigérateur oblige Sarah à brader les yaourts.
sentences.en: A fridge breakdown forces Sarah to sell off the yogurts cheaply.
sentences.ko: 냉장고가 고장 나서 사라는 요구르트를 싸게 팔아야 해요.

sentences.text: Après le soin, Antoine doit masser doucement sa joue pour détendre la mâchoire.
sentences.en: After the treatment, Antoine has to massage his cheek gently to relax his jaw.
sentences.ko: 치료가 끝나고 안토니는 턱을 풀려고 볼을 살살 주물러야 해요.

sentences.text: Le soir, le mari de Sarah lui masse les épaules après la fermeture.
sentences.en: In the evening, Sarah's husband massages her shoulders after closing time.
sentences.ko: 저녁에 가게 문을 닫으면 사라의 남편이 어깨를 주물러 줘요.

sentences.text: La dentiste conseille à Antoine d'éviter le sauna pendant quelques jours.
sentences.en: The dentist advises Antoine to avoid the sauna for a few days.
sentences.ko: 치과 의사가 안토니에게 며칠 동안 사우나를 피하라고 해요.

sentences.text: Le voisin de Sarah veut construire un sauna dans son jardin.
sentences.en: Sarah's neighbour wants to build a sauna in his garden.
sentences.ko: 사라의 이웃은 정원에 사우나를 지으려고 해요.

sentences.text: Antoine a bu trop de café et sent sa vessie pleine pendant le soin.
sentences.en: Antoine drank too much coffee and feels his bladder full during the treatment.
sentences.ko: 안토니는 커피를 너무 마셔서 치료 중에 소변이 마려워요.

sentences.text: Une cliente achète des tisanes pour la vessie et Sarah lui fait une réduction.
sentences.en: A customer buys herbal teas for her bladder, and Sarah gives her a discount.
sentences.ko: 방광에 좋은 허브차를 사는 손님에게 사라가 값을 깎아 줘요.

sentences.text: Le questionnaire demande à Antoine s'il a déjà eu une maladie pulmonaire.
sentences.en: The questionnaire asks Antoine whether he has ever had a lung disease.
sentences.ko: 문진표가 안토니에게 폐 질환을 앓은 적이 있는지 물어요.

sentences.text: Depuis qu'il a arrêté de fumer, le client préféré de Sarah a une meilleure capacité pulmonaire.
sentences.en: Since he quit smoking, Sarah's favourite customer has better lung capacity.
sentences.ko: 담배를 끊은 뒤로 사라가 아끼는 손님은 폐활량이 좋아졌어요.

sentences.text: Après l'extraction, Antoine a un hématome bleu sur la joue.
sentences.en: After the extraction, Antoine has a blue bruise on his cheek.
sentences.ko: 이를 뽑은 뒤 안토니의 볼에 파란 멍이 들어요.

sentences.text: Sarah s'est cognée contre une étagère et garde un hématome sur le bras.
sentences.en: Sarah bumped into a shelf and has a bruise on her arm.
sentences.ko: 사라는 선반에 부딪혀서 팔에 멍이 들었어요.

sentences.text: L'assistante d'Antoine a une manucure parfaite sous ses gants transparents.
sentences.en: Antoine's assistant has a perfect manicure under her clear gloves.
sentences.ko: 안토니를 돕는 위생사의 투명 장갑 아래로 깔끔한 매니큐어가 보여요.

sentences.text: Sarah vend aussi du vernis et des limes pour faire sa manucure à la maison.
sentences.en: Sarah also sells polish and nail files for doing your manicure at home.
sentences.ko: 사라는 집에서 손톱 손질을 할 수 있게 매니큐어와 손톱 줄도 팔아요.

sentences.text: Antoine plaisante en disant que son subconscient refuse d'aller chez le dentiste.
sentences.en: Antoine jokes that his subconscious refuses to go to the dentist.
sentences.ko: 안토니는 자기 무의식이 치과에 가기를 거부한다고 농담해요.

sentences.text: Selon Sarah, son subconscient se souvient du prix de chaque produit.
sentences.en: According to Sarah, her subconscious remembers the price of every product.
sentences.ko: 사라는 자기 무의식이 물건값을 다 기억한다고 해요.

sentences.text: La douleur à la dent donne des nuits d'insomnie à Antoine.
sentences.en: The toothache gives Antoine sleepless nights.
sentences.ko: 치통 때문에 안토니는 밤마다 잠을 못 자요.

sentences.text: Un chauffeur de taxi achète du café chez Sarah pour lutter contre l'insomnie.
sentences.en: A taxi driver buys coffee at Sarah's to fight his insomnia.
sentences.ko: 한 택시 기사가 불면을 견디려고 사라의 가게에서 커피를 사요.

sentences.text: En se rasant, Antoine s'est fait une petite entaille juste avant le rendez-vous.
sentences.en: While shaving, Antoine gave himself a small cut just before the appointment.
sentences.ko: 안토니는 진료 직전에 면도하다 살짝 베였어요.

sentences.text: En ouvrant un carton, Sarah se fait une entaille au pouce.
sentences.en: Opening a box, Sarah cuts her thumb.
sentences.ko: 사라는 상자를 뜯다가 엄지를 베여요.

sentences.text: Pour se calmer, Antoine écoute une méditation guidée dans la salle d'attente.
sentences.en: To calm down, Antoine listens to a guided meditation in the waiting room.
sentences.ko: 안토니는 마음을 가라앉히려고 대기실에서 명상 안내를 들어요.

sentences.text: Avant d'ouvrir le rideau, Sarah fait dix minutes de méditation.
sentences.en: Before raising the shutter, Sarah does ten minutes of meditation.
sentences.ko: 사라는 셔터를 올리기 전에 십 분 동안 명상을 해요.

sentences.text: Antoine se sent un peu affaibli après deux heures dans le fauteuil.
sentences.en: Antoine feels a bit weak after two hours in the chair.
sentences.ko: 안토니는 진료 의자에 두 시간 있었더니 기운이 좀 없어요.

sentences.text: Encore affaiblie par la grippe, Sarah laisse son fils tenir la caisse.
sentences.en: Still weakened by the flu, Sarah lets her son run the till.
sentences.ko: 아직 독감으로 기운이 없어서 사라는 아들에게 계산대를 맡겨요.

sentences.text: Le bavoir en papier d'Antoine descend presque jusqu'au nombril.
sentences.en: Antoine's paper bib comes down almost to his belly button.
sentences.ko: 안토니의 종이 턱받이가 배꼽까지 내려와요.

sentences.text: Le bébé de la cliente montre son nombril à Sarah en riant.
sentences.en: The customer's baby shows Sarah his belly button, laughing.
sentences.ko: 손님의 아기가 웃으면서 사라에게 배꼽을 보여 줘요.

sentences.text: La femme d'Antoine dit qu'il recommence à ronfler depuis son mal de dents.
sentences.en: Antoine's wife says he's started snoring again since his toothache.
sentences.ko: 안토니의 아내는 치통이 생긴 뒤로 안토니가 다시 코를 곤다고 해요.

sentences.text: Le chat de Sarah commence à ronfler sur les sacs de farine.
sentences.en: Sarah's cat starts snoring on the bags of flour.
sentences.ko: 사라의 고양이가 밀가루 포대 위에서 코를 골기 시작해요.

sentences.text: Sans sa brosse à dents de voyage, Antoine se sent complètement dépourvu.
sentences.en: Without his travel toothbrush, Antoine feels completely at a loss.
sentences.ko: 여행용 칫솔이 없으니 안토니는 완전히 난감해요.

sentences.text: Un dimanche sans pain, Sarah est prise au dépourvu par la foule.
sentences.en: One Sunday with no bread, Sarah is caught off guard by the crowd.
sentences.ko: 빵이 떨어진 어느 일요일, 사라는 몰려든 손님에 당황해요.

sentences.text: Le cabinet doit relancer Antoine trois fois pour qu'il prenne rendez-vous.
sentences.en: The surgery has to chase Antoine three times before he books an appointment.
sentences.ko: 병원이 세 번이나 연락해서야 안토니는 예약을 해요.

sentences.text: Sarah doit relancer son fournisseur, qui n'a pas livré le lait.
sentences.en: Sarah has to chase up her supplier, who hasn't delivered the milk.
sentences.ko: 우유가 안 와서 사라는 납품업자에게 다시 연락해야 해요.

sentences.text: Pour rassurer Antoine, la dentiste raconte le cas fictif d'un patient très peureux.
sentences.en: To reassure Antoine, the dentist tells the made-up case of a very fearful patient.
sentences.ko: 치과 의사는 안토니를 안심시키려고 겁 많은 환자의 가상 사례를 들려줘요.

sentences.text: Sur le ticket, Sarah voit l'adresse fictive d'un magasin qui n'existe pas.
sentences.en: On the receipt, Sarah sees the fake address of a shop that doesn't exist.
sentences.ko: 사라는 영수증에서 있지도 않은 가게의 가짜 주소를 봐요.

sentences.text: Antoine a l'impression d'être ligoté dans le fauteuil, tant il est tendu.
sentences.en: Antoine feels as if he's tied to the chair, he's so tense.
sentences.ko: 안토니는 너무 긴장해서 의자에 묶인 것 같은 기분이에요.

sentences.text: Sarah doit ligoter les journaux invendus avec de la ficelle.
sentences.en: Sarah has to tie up the unsold newspapers with string.
sentences.ko: 사라는 안 팔린 신문을 끈으로 묶어야 해요.

sentences.text: Avec un petit crochet, la dentiste vient sonder chaque dent d'Antoine.
sentences.en: With a small hook, the dentist probes each of Antoine's teeth.
sentences.ko: 치과 의사가 작은 갈고리로 안토니의 이를 하나하나 살펴요.

sentences.text: Avant de commander, Sarah aime sonder ses clients sur les nouveaux produits.
sentences.en: Before ordering, Sarah likes to sound out her customers about new products.
sentences.ko: 사라는 주문하기 전에 새 상품에 대해 손님들의 생각을 떠보는 걸 좋아해요.

sentences.text: La position allongée est inconfortable pour le dos d'Antoine.
sentences.en: Lying down is uncomfortable for Antoine's back.
sentences.ko: 누운 자세가 안토니의 허리에 불편해요.

sentences.text: Le tabouret derrière la caisse est inconfortable, alors Sarah en achète un nouveau.
sentences.en: The stool behind the till is uncomfortable, so Sarah buys a new one.
sentences.ko: 계산대 뒤 의자가 불편해서 사라는 새 의자를 사요.

sentences.text: La dentiste dit à Antoine que la douleur est relative et dépend de chacun.
sentences.en: The dentist tells Antoine that pain is relative and depends on the person.
sentences.ko: 치과 의사는 안토니에게 통증은 사람마다 다르다고 말해요.

sentences.text: Sarah vit dans un calme relatif depuis qu'un supermarché a fermé en face.
sentences.en: Sarah has had relative peace since a supermarket closed across the street.
sentences.ko: 맞은편 슈퍼가 문을 닫은 뒤로 사라는 비교적 여유로워요.

sentences.text: Le visage d'Antoine reste impénétrable quand la dentiste annonce le prix.
sentences.en: Antoine's face stays unreadable when the dentist announces the price.
sentences.ko: 치과 의사가 비용을 말해도 안토니의 얼굴은 아무 표정이 없어요.

sentences.text: Le vieux monsieur de la rue d'en face garde un air impénétrable, même avec Sarah.
sentences.en: The old man from across the street keeps an inscrutable look, even with Sarah.
sentences.ko: 건너편 할아버지는 사라 앞에서도 속을 알 수 없는 표정이에요.

sentences.text: Le goût du produit est un peu déplaisant, mais Antoine ne dit rien.
sentences.en: The taste of the product is a bit unpleasant, but Antoine says nothing.
sentences.ko: 약 맛이 좀 불쾌하지만 안토니는 아무 말도 안 해요.

sentences.text: Une odeur déplaisante sort de la poubelle, et Sarah la sort tout de suite.
sentences.en: An unpleasant smell comes from the bin, and Sarah takes it out right away.
sentences.ko: 쓰레기통에서 불쾌한 냄새가 나서 사라는 바로 내다 놓아요.

sentences.text: À l'accueil, Antoine doit cocher les cases de ses allergies.
sentences.en: At reception, Antoine has to tick the boxes for his allergies.
sentences.ko: 접수처에서 안토니는 알레르기 칸에 표시를 해야 해요.

sentences.text: Sur sa liste de commandes, Sarah coche les produits déjà arrivés.
sentences.en: On her order list, Sarah ticks off the products that have already arrived.
sentences.ko: 사라는 주문 목록에서 이미 들어온 상품에 표시해요.

sentences.text: Les avis d'Antoine et de sa femme sont divisés sur l'appareil dentaire de leur fille.
sentences.en: Antoine and his wife have divided opinions on their daughter's braces.
sentences.ko: 딸의 치아 교정을 두고 안토니와 아내의 의견이 갈려요.

sentences.text: Le quartier est divisé sur l'ouverture de la boutique de Sarah le dimanche.
sentences.en: The neighbourhood is divided over Sarah's shop opening on Sundays.
sentences.ko: 사라의 가게가 일요일에 문을 여는 것을 두고 동네 의견이 갈려요.

sentences.text: Si la douleur persiste, Antoine doit rappeler le cabinet dès lundi.
sentences.en: If the pain persists, Antoine must call the surgery back on Monday.
sentences.ko: 통증이 계속되면 안토니는 월요일에 바로 병원에 다시 전화해야 해요.

sentences.text: Malgré la pluie, Sarah persiste à mettre les fruits devant la boutique.
sentences.en: Despite the rain, Sarah keeps putting the fruit out in front of the shop.
sentences.ko: 비가 와도 사라는 꿋꿋이 가게 앞에 과일을 내놓아요.

sentences.text: Les termes techniques finissent par embrouiller Antoine, qui demande une explication simple.
sentences.en: The technical terms end up confusing Antoine, who asks for a simple explanation.
sentences.ko: 전문 용어에 헷갈린 안토니가 쉽게 설명해 달라고 해요.

sentences.text: Les nouvelles étiquettes de prix risquent d'embrouiller les clients, craint Sarah.
sentences.en: The new price labels could confuse customers, Sarah fears.
sentences.ko: 사라는 새 가격표가 손님들을 헷갈리게 할까 봐 걱정해요.

sentences.text: La dentiste a soigné d'innombrables caries, mais celle d'Antoine l'étonne.
sentences.en: The dentist has treated countless cavities, but Antoine's surprises her.
sentences.ko: 치과 의사는 충치를 수없이 치료했지만 안토니의 충치에는 놀라요.

sentences.text: La boutique de Sarah propose d'innombrables sortes de bonbons.
sentences.en: Sarah's shop offers countless kinds of sweets.
sentences.ko: 사라의 가게에는 사탕 종류가 셀 수 없이 많아요.

sentences.text: Antoine se sent submergé par les conseils sur le fil dentaire et les bains de bouche.
sentences.en: Antoine feels overwhelmed by all the advice about floss and mouthwash.
sentences.ko: 안토니는 치실과 가글에 관한 조언이 너무 많아 정신이 없어요.

sentences.text: À la sortie de l'école, les enfants viennent submerger la petite boutique de Sarah.
sentences.en: When school lets out, the children flood Sarah's little shop.
sentences.ko: 학교가 끝나면 아이들이 사라의 작은 가게로 몰려들어요.

sentences.text: La dentiste trouve judicieux de soigner Antoine avant ses vacances.
sentences.en: The dentist thinks it wise to treat Antoine before his holiday.
sentences.ko: 치과 의사는 휴가 전에 안토니를 치료하는 게 현명하다고 봐요.

sentences.text: Mettre le pain près de l'entrée était un choix judicieux, constate Sarah.
sentences.en: Putting the bread near the entrance was a smart choice, Sarah notices.
sentences.ko: 사라는 빵을 입구 가까이 둔 게 현명한 선택이었다는 걸 알아요.
